title: Protein Extraction and Quantification from Mouse Tissues or Cells
author: sriparna.mukherjee
materials: Protein quantification with a EZQ Kit:

Load 1 µL of ovalbumin standard solutions and samples on the membrane from the EZQ kit. Perform triplicates for each. Be careful to not damage the membrane - avoid to touch it when loading the samples.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary lysis solutions for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare RIPA-based lysis buffer by mixing RIPA buffer with protease inhibitor cocktail (1/2000); add phosphatase inhibitor cocktail (1/2000) if necessary.

Prepare Laemmli-based lysis solution by mixing 1 mL 4x Laemmli Sample Buffer with 3 mL MilliQ water, then add β-mercaptoethanol and protease inhibitor cocktail (1/2000); add phosphatase inhibitor cocktail (1/2000) if necessary.

steps.title: Extract Protein from Tissues
steps.instruction: Isolate proteins from mouse tissue samples.

substeps.instruction: For brain samples, perfuse mice with 1X PBS before dissection.
Dissect tissue and transfer immediately to cold lysis buffer for homogenization, or freeze in a dry tube with dry ice and store at -80 °C.
Homogenize tissue using an Ultra-Turrax T8 homogenizer, maintaining consistent lysis volumes (e.g., 700 µL per striatum and 300 µL per mesencephalon).
Centrifuge homogenates at 12000 rpm, 4 °C, for 30 minutes.
Carefully collect the supernatant without disturbing insoluble material.
Rinse cells with 1X PBS (cells may be stored without media at -80 °C at this step).
Add 100 µL of lysis solution per million cells per well.
Scrape the bottom of the well with a P10 tip until all material is collected and a liquid solution is obtained.
Transfer the sample to an Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Reduce Solution Viscosity
steps.instruction: Treat samples with Benzonase to reduce viscosity, particularly for microglia and astrocytes.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of benzonase per 100 µL sample (or 1 µL per 50 µL for microglia and astrocytes).
Cells can be stored at -80 °C at this step.

steps.title: Quantify Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration using the BCA assay.

substeps.instruction: Prepare standards by making serial dilutions of 10 mg/mL ovalbumin stock solution using Laemmli lysis solution as the dilution buffer (at least five concentrations covering 0.02 mg/mL – 5 mg/mL), including a blank (Laemmli lysis solution only).
Add 20 µL of autoclaved MilliQ Water and 5 µL of sample to a 96-well flat-bottom plate.
Prepare a 1/50 CuSO4 solution in BCA buffer and add 200 µL of this solution to each well.
Cover the plate in aluminum foil and incubate for 25 minutes at 37 °C.
Read absorbance with a plate reader at 562 nm.
Protein can be stored at -20 °C or -80 °C (long-term) at this step.

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Western Blot
steps.instruction: Denature and normalize lysates for gel loading.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/4 of the sample into either a DTT or B-Me denaturing solution.
Prepare DTT denaturing solution: 500 µL loader + 7 mg DTT; heat for 30 minutes at 37 °C, then chill on ice.
Prepare B-Me denaturing solution: 500 µL loader + 10 µL B-Me; heat for 5 minutes at 95 °C, then chill on ice.
Normalize all samples to a common concentration suitable for gel loading.
Heat at 95 °C for 10 minutes and chill on ice (proteins can be stored at -20 °C at this step).

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Cytokine Assay
steps.instruction: Adjust lysate concentration for secreted protein measurement.

substeps.instruction: Adjust each lysate concentration to contain 30 μg total protein per tube.
Freeze samples at -80 °C for later use.

steps.title: Perform Membrane Processing
steps.instruction: Process the membrane using methanol and EZQ solution.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the membrane in a methanol bath (30 mL - 40 mL) for 5 minutes with agitation under a fume hood.
Dry with a hair dryer without heat for 1 minute (or 10 minutes if done without a dryer).
Place the membrane in 30 mL EZQ solution, protect from light, and incubate for 30 minutes under agitation under a fume hood.
Wash 3 times for 2 minutes each with washing buffer (10% methanol, 7% acetic acid).
Dry with a hair dryer without heat for 1 minute (or 10 minutes if done without a dryer).
Read with a plate reader at 618 nm (proteins can be stored at -20 °C at this step).
